question: How do Aha research and explanation skills make mechanisms understandable through three concrete examples and existing formats?
report:
# Aha: evidence made visible

## Direct answer
Aha provides two portable skills rather than an automatic pipeline: aha-research investigates a question and preserves a supported report with evidence and limitations; aha-explain authors a visual explanation for the requested medium. The host coordinates the work. Three bounded mechanisms demonstrate this relationship immediately: a fixed Mercator map changes Greenland's apparent footprint when its boundary is rotated on a sphere; a new CPython string changes its internal slot width while UTF-8 remains variable-length; and Docker's merged view can hide a path without removing its earlier layer payload. Existing Git artifacts demonstrate actual format availability, not four completed formats for these three video-only cases.

## Scope, purpose, audience and budget
This new snapshot supports an approximately 100-second English introduction for a curious adult first-time viewer. The authoring budget is 90–120 seconds at normal Aria rate, not a measured duration. Research scope is a provided-material synthesis of three sealed local dossiers, current installed skill documents and the current gallery. No primary web source was revisited, no upstream implementation was newly fetched, no experiment or authored browser code was executed, and no speech, installation or publishing occurred. The research time horizon is the local state inspected on 2026-09-17; inherited facts retain their original source dates and pins.

## Question tree and method
q-skills establishes what the product is before any example. q-map, q-python and q-docker each ask what changes, what stays fixed, and why the visible result follows. q-formats then checks actual saved artifacts instead of generalizing from a supported output type. q-review separates static readiness from observed performance. All three reused Dossiers passed research-validate before reuse; those checks establish snapshot integrity, not newly verified external truth. Read scope: the complete three report.md files, installed aha-research and aha-explain SKILL.md, required workflow/authoring/video/language/design/execution guides, current examples/README.md, selected artifact metadata and receipts, the first 145 lines of the previous overview scenes.js (including the complete geographic transform), and the first 45 lines plus native shape/text patterns of Git's slide author source. Only targeted Git HTML control/source excerpts were inspected. No PPTX file was opened or parsed. The full current upstream CPython and Moby codebases were not read by this author.

## Mechanism 1: Greenland
The reused Greenland dossier explains spherical Mercator's growing high-latitude enlargement. The map keeps longitude spacing fixed even though spherical meridians converge; preserving local angles requires matching north-south enlargement. A rigid spherical rotation applies one transformation to every Greenland boundary point. It preserves spherical area while its footprint on a fixed Mercator projection changes. The authored source adapts the existing conjugated D3 rotation, with fixed scale and translation; it must not fit or shrink the polygon in two dimensions. Natural Earth 5.1.2 generalized boundaries are not precision area measurements. The projection is explicitly spherical Mercator with polar cropping. The movement is a counterfactual geometric relocation, not real continental motion. Original PROJ/Esri/D3/Natural Earth readings remain inherited evidence, not newly visited sources. The official Greenland statistics PDF extraction gap persists. Area ratios, detailed projection derivation and equal-area alternatives are deliberately outside this short argument.

## Mechanism 2: CPython
The reused CPython dossier pins 3.11.15 to commit 2340a037f7450e70fccfe411e6531afb4d57a312. Its PEP 393 and selected PyUnicode_Concat/PyUnicode_New/header/sizeof readings support a uniform one-, two- or four-byte representation for the resulting compact str. U+1F600 exceeds U+FFFF, so a new result containing it needs four-byte code-point slots, including its ASCII prefix. Concat combines operand representation ranges; this is not a claim that every concat scans all code points. The original immutable str remains unchanged. The inherited parent-observed local values are str object sizes 100049 and 400080 bytes, versus UTF-8 payload lengths 100000 and 100004 bytes. These are not new measurements, whole-process sizes, written-file sizes, or exact fourfold totals. UTF-8 keeps the ASCII prefix at one byte per code point; U+1F600 adds four bytes. The source shows schematic slots and exact recorded totals, not 100000 individual cells. Not every emoji, all non-ASCII text, or every Python implementation has this behavior. Intermediate Latin-1/BMP examples remain in research rather than narration.

## Mechanism 3: Docker
The reused Docker dossier pins Moby 27.5.1 to 4c9b3b011ae4c30145a7b344c870bdda01b454e2 and OCI image-spec to af26a05fba5ee648512f4ea3c9fda1fcc1b6d6dc. An ordinary unsquashed image records new file content in a layer. A later deletion changes the merged view through a whiteout without rewriting the earlier immutable blob. The cutaway must retain the payload while the merged example path disappears; the whiteout is a layer entry, never an ordinary visible file in the merged view. A NEW temporary file absent both before and after one RUN contributes no payload for that path to the resulting diff. This does not make the whole layer empty or reclaim a preexisting base-layer file. The 100 MB means an illustrative uncompressed 100000000-byte payload, not a Docker build observation, compressed image size, transfer size, cache usage or physical storage measurement. The inherited Moby trace covers classic dispatchRun and selected fallback diff/archive/whiteout paths, not every BuildKit backend. No Docker build was run. Running-container writable-layer behavior is omitted rather than conflated with image layers.

## Actual formats, not invented completion
The current examples/README.md lists ANC, Git and the official older project-overview in HTML, PNG, native PPTX and narrated video. Greenland, CPython and Docker are video-only. The newer 166.43-second Greenland overview under artifacts is a candidate, not the published official overview. This introduction uses existing Git PNG pixels, an earlier actual HTML screenshot, an existing slide-03 native-slide render, and a video still. The screenshot shows saved rendered HTML, not a live interactive element in this video. Native slide availability is supported by saved artifact metadata/receipt and native addText/addShape author source, not inferred from its raster preview; no fresh editability test is claimed. Preview assets retain exact original bytes and provenance. One HTML screenshot was visually returned by the image tool; other requested images hit the image-view limit, so their current visual inspection is unperformed. Existing QA provenance does not certify this new composition.

## Semantic reverse-check and counterevidence
The narration distinguishes map area from spherical area, new str from original str, internal memory from UTF-8 payload, and a hidden path from retained bytes. The Docker same-RUN claim is bounded to a new temporary file. The format close names Git as the existing multi-format example; no script implies all three main cases have four outputs. The two skills are introduced before the demonstrations, with host coordination explicit. The closing evidence-to-mechanism relationship is editorial synthesis, not an efficacy experiment. Structural validation, source-level semantic review and actual visual/audio QA remain separate. No learner, browser replay, measured pacing or continuous playback result is invented.

## Local state and stopping reason
Inspected HEAD was 6aefe1af5d8fb0ba8d504a36b747783adb0cf3f2. Existing uncommitted modifications were README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/EVALUATION.md, evals/examples/verify.mjs, examples/README.md, examples/delivery-manifest.json, examples/index.html and tests/example-identity.test.ts; untracked publication paths were evals/examples/code-pilots-20260917/, examples/cpython-string/ and examples/docker-layers/. They were not changed by this task. Only the new artifacts/overview-three-examples-20260917 root is owned. Core claims are supported within the reused-material budget. Stop at inert source and narration readiness; parent approval and actual offline previews, pilot/full speech, rendering and audiovisual review remain necessary.
